evidence: Manual source review of the assigned prompt requirement passes. Paths below are relative to frozen task .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/task/. Each of the five tests/{gates/render,gates/constraints,scored/functional,scored/polish,scored/visual}/prompt.md files begins at line 1 with the live http://localhost:3000 URL and an explicit Playwright MCP instruction (render/constraints continue onto line 2). All five judge.toml files wire playwright-mcp at lines 8-12 and prompt_template at line 6. Source evidence is explicitly forbidden at render and constraints prompt.md:6, functional prompt.md:7, and polish and visual prompt.md:5. Functional distinguishes user-entered snippet data from implementation and states that reading it does not prove execution. The shared context is actually injected by tests/test.sh:195-200. First-paint shortcuts are excluded by concrete actions: render/judge.toml:25 requires a newly authored marker in the actual preview and console after pressing Run; constraints/judge.toml:25-27 requires an observed UI save followed by retrieval and reload in an independent clean browser context. Functional/prompt.md:9 requires execution of the phase plan, with later live click/key actions at 157-161, timed cancellation at 169-180, reload/readbacks at 414-420 and a reported process restart followed by live reads at 426-429. Polish/prompt.md:47-49 requires real keyboard navigation rather than programmatic focus or DOM clicks; its judge.toml:23 requires reaching and using surfaces at roughly 390 by 844. Visual/prompt.md:44-46 requires multiple desktop/mobile surfaces and both offered themes, and lines 55-62 require rendered support for scores and prohibit fabricated viewed surfaces. Browser actions and observed product-data requests are allowed; source, memory, and a still first paint cannot satisfy the complete dimension prompts. Reasoned counterexample checks (not runtime executions): a polished static editor with a hardcoded console cannot satisfy the Render authored Run, and a localStorage-only save cannot satisfy the Constraints clean-context retrieval. A conforming app with native controls, drawers, a server-rendered library and an opaque preview sandbox remains admissible: functional/prompt.md:5,13, polish/prompt.md:45-49 and visual/prompt.md:44-48 accept purpose-based controls, rendered server data and flexible layouts without reading implementation. No row-25 defect was found.
